digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs and output formatting
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently follow Unix silence rule with empty stdout on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from writes, causing downstream agents to issue spurious follow-up reads and misinterpret failures.

Verbs must emit one-line kubectl-style confirmations indicating past-tense verb, argument summary, and outcome (write or no-op) built only from CLI args and seam result, without follow-up store reads.

Global flags --quiet/-q and --output/-o must be extracted uniformly at the top-level router before partition dispatch, enabling all in-scope verbs (including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves) to support both flags with --quiet suppressing text confirmations only and --output json producing a single valid JSON document.
Existing consumed seam returns (e.g. add_dependency dict|None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged; confirmations derive from what the seam exposes without altering consumed value types.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must normalize to the shared confirmation contract preserving all existing data; link's REDIRECT record must remain byte-identical with no extra confirmation line added on top.
Confirmations print to stdout with logs on stderr; exit codes and existing contracts remain unchanged; all affected verbs and downstream consumers must migrate to the new output format.
